`enum ResourceNode.StretchType`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.resource` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourceNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/resource/ResourceNode.java)

How an image or a video fills bounds whose ratio differs from its own.

## Learn more

- [Images and media](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/media/#fit-tint-and-crop)
- [Show a video](/use/guides/show-a-video/)

<a id="ResourceNode-StretchType-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `void` | [draw](#ResourceNode-StretchType-method-draw)(double x, double y, double width, double height, Resource resource) | Draws the resource in these bounds with this fit. |

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`STRETCH`](#ResourceNode-StretchType-value-STRETCH) | Fills the bounds, deforming the image. |
| [`CONTAIN`](#ResourceNode-StretchType-value-CONTAIN) | Shows the whole image, centered, as large as the bounds allow; the rest of the bounds stays empty. |
| [`COVER`](#ResourceNode-StretchType-value-COVER) | Fills the bounds with the image, centered, and crops what goes past them. |

### CONTAIN

`CONTAIN`
